messages:
sophia: FYI I noticed the 2026-03-01 invoice batch has two issues: some customers missing GPU compute line items and an invoice_id collision where `inv_20260301_907` is assigned twice. @tom @raj can you peek at billing-render logs?

 tom: on it. which accounts?

 sophia: cust_8921 and cust_1102 missing gpu_hours. Duplicate id shows on cust_5510 and cust_6600.

 billing-bot: generator_v2 runs: 2026-03-01T02:00Z run_984 status=success; 2026-03-01T02:15Z run_985 status=partial warnings=render_skip_for_missing_usage; 2026-03-01T02:45Z run_986 status=success.

 raj: run_985 flagged missing usage rows. I traced a recent change in usage_exporter serializer (PR #4310) that drops `gpu_hours` when usage_type=spot. tagging eng-runtime.

 tom: finance: please pause collections for affected accounts. I'll prepare a re-run plan to regenerate invoices for run_985 and mark corrected PDFs with `-rev1`.

 sophia: Agreed. eng-runtime, please patch or rollback PR #4310 ASAP. I'll write a short incident note after we validate fixes.
